messages.subject: display of ECDF
parts:
Dear all,

please could you advise me on the following : I would like to display a few CDF data (the R code is below), by using a set of numerical BREAKS on a X axis to be shown at EQUAL DISTANCE from each other (although numerically, the BREAKS are on log10 axis and do not reflecting an equal distance):

df <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(100, 0, 3), rnorm(100, 0, 10)),
  g = gl(2, 100)
)

breaks=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 100)

ggplot(df, aes(x, colour = g)) + stat_ecdf()  + scale_x_log10(breaks=breaks), 

how shall I do it ? thanks a lot !

-- bogdan

messages.author: 272fb71d6c54a687
messages.subject: Re: display of ECDF
parts:
Hi Bogdan,

What do you mean by "Equal distance"? In your example, those break points are not uniformly distributed (neither in original form or after log transformed). 
For example 0.1 is 10-fold smaller than 1, but the next break, "5", is 5-fold bigger than 1. Do you want these two number to be represent in the x-axis with equally distance from "1"?
My guess is if you can define a function to transform those breaks back into a linear scale, you should be able to use that to transform your data and plot them.

Best,
Kavee
